name: houdini_execute_code
description: DANGEROUS: run Python in the attached Houdini (hou), given as code or as a script file (path). Assign a JSON-able dict to `result`; print() output is returned. A run that changes the scene is one undo group; a failing one is undone, and a failure says what Houdini knows (closest node types or parm names, node errors, the function's signature). Every run asks permission.

path.description: A .py file to run instead of code, read as is (absolute or relative to the project): long scripts, no escaping.
